title: Manifest Validation
description: Comprehensive validation of pack manifest.json files. Validates format version, UUIDs, header properties, modules, dependencies, subpacks, capabilities, and settings. Ensures manifests comply with Minecraft Bedrock Edition requirements.

101.title: Invalid Format
101.description: The manifest format_version is not a recognized value. Valid format versions are 1, 2, or 3. Use format_version 2 for most modern packs.
101.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid format_version value

102.title: Schema Error
102.description: The manifest.json file does not conform to the expected JSON schema. Check for missing required properties, incorrect property types, or structural errors.
102.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains details about the schema violation

103.title: Manifest Count
103.description: Each pack must have exactly one manifest.json file at its root. Multiple manifests or missing manifests indicate a pack structure problem.
103.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the number of manifests found

104.title: Missing Property
104.description: A required property is missing from the manifest header section. Common required properties include name, description, uuid, and version.
104.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the name of the missing property

105.title: Required Property
105.description: A header property that is optional in format_version 1 is required in format_version 2 and above. Update your manifest to include all required header properties.
105.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the property name now required

106.title: Version Mismatch
106.description: The min_engine_version specified requires format_version 2. Either lower the min_engine_version or upgrade to format_version 2.
106.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the conflicting version values

107.title: Invalid Scope
107.description: The pack_scope property must be one of: 'global', 'world', or 'any'. Other values are not recognized.
107.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid pack_scope value

108.title: Multiple Templates
108.description: The manifest modules array can contain at most one world_template module. Remove extra world_template entries.
108.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the count of world_template modules

109.title: Invalid Module
109.description: A module has an unrecognized type. Valid module types include: persona_piece, world_template, skin_pack, data, script, and resources.
109.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid module type

110.title: Duplicate UUID
110.description: A UUID is used more than once in the manifest. All UUIDs must be unique across header, modules, and dependencies. Generate new unique UUIDs for duplicates.

111.title: Invalid UUID
111.description: A UUID does not conform to the standard UUID format (xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx). Generate a valid UUID using a UUID generator tool.
111.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid UUID value

112.title: Missing Dep ID
112.description: A dependency entry is missing both 'module_name' and 'uuid'. Each dependency must have at least one identifier to specify which module it depends on.
112.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the dependency index missing an ID

113.title: Duplicate Dep ID
113.description: A dependency has both 'module_name' and 'uuid' specified. Use only one identifier per dependency - either module_name (for script modules) or uuid (for packs).
113.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the dependency with duplicate IDs

114.title: Invalid Module Name
114.description: The specified module_name is not in the list of allowed script modules. Valid module names include @minecraft/server, @minecraft/server-ui, etc.

115.title: Version Parse Error
115.description: A version number could not be parsed. Versions should be arrays of 3 numbers [major, minor, patch] or semantic version strings.

116.title: Version Too Low
116.description: The specified version is lower than the minimum required version for this module or dependency. Update to a supported version.
116.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the version and minimum required

117.title: Invalid Capability
117.description: An unrecognized capability is listed. Currently, 'pbr' is the only allowed capability for declaring Vibrant Visuals support.
117.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid capability name

118.title: Duplicate Folder
118.description: The same folder name is used by multiple subpacks. Each subpack must reference a unique folder path.
118.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the duplicate folder name

119.title: Duplicate Subpack
119.description: The same name is used by multiple subpacks. Each subpack must have a unique identifier name.
119.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the duplicate subpack name

120.title: Invalid Subpack
120.description: A subpack name is invalid or empty. Provide a valid name for each subpack entry.
120.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid subpack name

121.title: Invalid Tier
121.description: A subpack memory_tier value is below the minimum allowed. Memory tiers must meet or exceed the baseline requirement.
121.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid memory_tier value

122.title: Settings Missing
122.description: A settings entry is missing a required property. Settings require name, type, and other properties depending on the setting type.
122.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the missing settings property name

123.title: Invalid Setting
123.description: A settings entry has an unrecognized type. Valid types include 'slider' and 'dropdown'.
123.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid setting type

124.title: Invalid Min/Max
124.description: For slider settings, the 'min' value must be less than the 'max' value.
124.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid min/max values

125.title: Slider Default
125.description: For slider settings, the default value must be a number between min and max (inclusive).
125.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid default value

126.title: Dropdown Default
126.description: For dropdown settings, the default value must be one of the values in the options list.
126.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid dropdown default

127.title: Invalid Step
127.description: For slider settings, the step value must be greater than 0 and less than (max - min).
127.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid step value

128.title: Duplicate Setting
128.description: Multiple settings share the same name. Each setting must have a unique name identifier.
128.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the duplicate setting name

129.title: Missing Namespace
129.description: Settings names must be namespaced using the format 'namespace:setting_name'. Add a namespace prefix with a colon separator.
129.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the setting name missing namespace

130.title: Few Options
130.description: Dropdown settings must have at least 2 options to choose from.
130.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the number of options found

131.title: Duplicate Option
131.description: A dropdown setting has duplicate values in its options list. Each option must be unique.
131.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the duplicate option value

132.title: Base Version Error
132.description: The base_game_version property requires format_version 2 or higher. Either remove base_game_version or upgrade to format_version 2.
132.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the conflicting version info

133.title: Wildcard Version
133.description: Using wildcards (like [1, 21, *]) in base_game_version is not recommended. Specify an exact version for more predictable behavior.
133.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the version with wildcard

134.title: PBR Engine Version
134.description: Packs declaring the 'pbr' capability for Vibrant Visuals must have min_engine_version of at least 1.21.120.

135.title: Missing PBR Cap
135.description: The pack contains PBR-related files (like .texture_set.json or *_mer.png) but does not declare the 'pbr' capability in the manifest. Add 'capabilities': ['pbr'] to your manifest.
135.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the PBR file path found
